hotel_name: Lime Tree Hotel Near Medanta Gurgaon

positive_snippets: Had a really pleasant stay here! The staff was very friendly and accommodating—when I faced a small issue, they promptly upgraded me to another room. The amenities were great, with a smart TV and everything well-maintained. Overall, a comfortable and enjoyable experience!
It was an exceptional experience to stay here in Lime Tree Hotel medanta. The staff was polite and friendly. Particularly Ms. Shalini and Mr. Gaurav were very humble and generous.
Great staff Shalini & Gaurav very cooperative during the period of stay good food & great service will surely recommend to friends & family.
